## Layout & Spacing

All dimensions are Android dp (layout) and sp (type).

| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `{spacing.1}` · `{spacing.2}` · `{spacing.3}` | 4 · 8 · 12 dp | Inside components; word-card gaps |
| `{spacing.4}` · `{spacing.5}` | 16 · 24 dp | Default gap, tray padding · yes/no gap, tablet row gaps |
| `{spacing.6}` · `{spacing.7}` | 32 · 48 dp | Parent-area section breaks |
| `{spacing.rail-top}` | 72 dp | Top rail |
| `{spacing.control-primary}` · `{spacing.control-secondary}` | 128 · 64 dp | Primary child control (NFR-13: ≥ 126 dp) · secondary `[ASSUMPTION]` |
| Medium or expanded, portrait | ≥ 600 dp wide, taller than wide | — | 548 / 582 dp | A confirmation: the Yes/no pair under the Caption bubble, above Pip |
| Landscape | ≥ 600 dp wide, at least as wide as tall | — | 388 / 422 dp | A confirmation, as above; the control columns alone need 376 dp |

Inputs: rail 72 dp; compact band 304 dp; medium band 160 dp; landscape columns 304 dp under the rail; Caption bubble chrome 24 dp and Narrator frame chrome 32 dp (vertical); line heights from Typography; a two-line word in a confirmation; Yes/no pair 128 dp with 16 dp gaps; AI-notice card pictures 56 dp on compact, 72 dp otherwise; Pip at 64 dp where no voice turn can start. A 360 × 640 dp phone with a 3-button bar (592 dp usable) fits at both text scales; an old 16:9 phone at the largest Display size (≈ 320 × 569 dp, 521 dp usable) does not, and pauses.

### Child sub-screens

- **Shelf & diary:** two 128 dp tabs. The shelf holds Word cards, then Keepsake cubbies, in as many 96 dp columns as fit (3 at 360 dp, 2 below 344 dp). The diary shows one Diary page.
- **Show-and-tell camera:** the camera view fills the top ~60% with `{rounded.lg}` corners. The Pip frame and the choice area sit beside the camera view (below it on compact portrait; at its side at ≥ 600 dp and in landscape), never over it. Compact portrait, top to bottom: camera view (~60%); Narrator frame; then the Pip frame (160 dp) at the left with its Caption bubble above it, tail into the frame, and the choice area to its right or below: the Yes/no pair, three prop pictures (Child controls) or the Swatches. During a confirmation the frozen camera image shrinks so the Pip frame and Yes/no pair fit below it `[ASSUMPTION]`. Without a narrator line, the camera view takes the Narrator frame's slot. At all times on this screen the rail holds only the back control and the background is `room-wall` `[ASSUMPTION]`.

- **Sleeping Pip:** `sleep-dim` 40%; only the wave, sign and doors remain `[ASSUMPTION: CQ-13, CQ-22]`.
- On sub-screens, a back Small child control (`ui_back.png`) takes the sign's slot `[ASSUMPTION]`.
